item.title: Regional Halal Restaurant Chain to Open Downtown State College Location
item.description: A growing regional chain of fast casual halal restaurants is coming to downtown State College. Sizzling Bites Halal Grill is planning to open at 129 S. Pugh St., according to signage on the building and information presented earlier this year at a State College Redevelopment Authority meeting. The location has been vacant since Sheetz closed its store there in 2023 after eight years in business. An opening date has not yet been announced. The chain plans to post updates on its Instagram account.

item.title: Photos: Ice Sculptors Craft Creative Designs at First Night State College
item.description: First Night State College is known for its ice sculptures — one of the largest displays of its kind in Pennsylvania — and sculptors were hard at work Wednesday morning and afternoon crafting the creative designs that are an annual highlight of the New Year's Eve celebration. item.title: Reports: Penn State to Hire Ikaika Malloe as Defensive Line Coach
item.description: Matt Campbell has selected another position coach. Ikaika Malloe will serve as Penn State's defensive line coach, according to multiple reports, replacing Deion Barnes, who recently left for the same role at South Carolina. Malloe most recently served as UCLA's defensive coordinator, but parted ways with the team when head coach Deshaun Foster was fired after an 0-3 start — two games before the Bruins defeated the Nittany Lions 42-37.
